description: End-to-end health check of the discord-mcp setup: token presence and validity, privileged gateway intent toggles, Discord's growth thresholds (App Verification by servers, intent review by users), default guild membership, whether this install runs from npm's temporary npx cache, how destructive actions get confirmed in this app, and leftovers from before the 2.0 rename. Every failed check comes with instructions for fixing it. With more than one bot configured, pass bot to check a specific one. Run this first when anything misbehaves.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot, or with a server, the bot that handles it.

name: run_setup_check
title: Run setup check
